ordered_audit_heads_projection: plan-case-prefix order: [{run_id, final_chain_head_sha256}]; SHA256(domain || NUL || tag || NUL || canonical(projection))
verification_rules: All seven exact files must be regular, single-link, non-reparse files under the bounded directory reader; reject extras, WAL/SHM sidecars and missing files.
Scan all exact file bytes before SQLite opening, including NUL-separated data; validate strict canonical JSON and reject duplicate keys.
Verify manifest and each declared payload size/SHA against independent expected manifest bytes hash.
Verify the pinned SQLite schema and bind query results to the same serialized database image before and after reads; re-read all seven files before returning.
Verify each actual audit hash chain and its indexed head/count in preregistered case-prefix order, with independently expected run IDs.
Recompute bridge start/terminal hashes and require exactly one start/terminal per observed attempt; no supplied projections are accepted.
Every completion terminal is v1.2; legacy terminal versions cannot be silently upgraded or used as timing evidence.
Validate live-record semantics through the readonly persisted-evidence context; mint no runtime binding.
Recompute record/usage digests from that same terminal and compare its v1.2 reference with the complete timing segment.
Require event attempts and accepted records to equal the validated runtime denominator; compare case order and caps against the independent denominator plan.
Derive the timing terminal projection from actual rows, then apply the shared numeric/coverage/plan/execution/publication validator.
Do not trust input closure or reconciliation booleans as proof; full budget/tool/source/consumption/signature/registry and A/B semantics remain separate required gates.
